nodes.name: Ancient AI Core
nodes.eventIntro: The interior atmospheric sensors flicker to life. A faint cybernetic hum resonates through the bulkhead.
nodes.eventDescription: Deep within the sunken vessel, a dormant intelligence awakens.

actions.resultDescription: Data extracted successfully.

nodes.name: Field Research
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: spawn on Biome 01, Biome 06, Biome 10 = shallow any island
nodes.spawnConditions: spawn on Biome 01, Biome 06, Biome 10 = shallow any island
nodes.eventIntro: Your scouts find a lot of animals' carcasses. Studying them could be useful.
nodes.eventDescription: While exploring the island, your scouts discover a group of dead and dying land animals scattered along the shore. They are apparently struck by an unknown disease. Examining them could help you learn more about local viruses or toxins.

actions.resultDescription: Your scouts thoroughly examined the animal carcasses and collected  samples from both diseased and apparently healthy organs and tissues. These samples will improve your understanding of the local fauna.

Your scouts thoroughly examined the animal carcasses and collected samples from both diseased and apparently healthy organs and tissues. After further research and adjustments to the medical lab, the scouts reported that the virus had been neutralized and no longer posed a threat to humans or your food supplies.

Your scouts thoroughly examined the animal carcasses and collected samples from both diseased and apparently healthy organs and tissues. After further research and adjustments to the medical lab, they developed a custom batch of MedGel that not only neutralized the virus but also reversed its effects, saving several creatures on the brink of death.

nodes.name: Supply Beacon
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.eventIntro: A supply beacon has crashed. Something inside might still be useful.
nodes.eventDescription: The supply beacon has crashed into the island and turned into a jumble of metal. Whatever contents it transported must have been smashed into smithereens and less. And yet, with proper tools, your specialists may be able to salvage something.

actions.resultDescription: Your specialists cut through the damaged hull and recovered the cargo stored inside. The salvaged supplies  have been added to your stockpile.
Your specialists dismantled the beacon and sorted the wreckage, recovering reusable  materials.
Your specialists carefully removed the surviving electronics from the beacon's hull, recovering useful components.

nodes.name: Distress Call
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.eventIntro: A wrecked escape pod is on fire. There may be survivors inside.
nodes.eventDescription: The escape pod must have crashed into the island with high enough speed, given its battered appearance. What is worse — it is now on fire. Your people start shouting to identify if there are survivors inside.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Crew members challenged your decision, arguing that saving lives was a fundamental human duty. Your order not to intervene sparked prolonged debates in the crew quarters, lowering morale.

actions.resultDescription: Your specialists picked the lock, but wiring, damaged while pod had crushed, electrified the capsules hull. One crew member suffered an electric shock during the operation. However all three survivors were rescued and joined your crew, boosting morale.

Your specialists slowly melted  through the lock. The air pressure between an airlock and outside the capsule equilized, allowing them to open the door safely. All three survivors were rescued and joined your crew, boosting morale.

Your specialists forced the pod open with a crafted lever. The  pressure difference between a hatch and the outside  caused explosive decompression. All three survivors were injured  as well as one of your crew. But all survivors were rescued and joined your crew, boosting morale.

nodes.name: Cave system
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.eventDescription: During a scouting expedition along the shore, a crew member hears a strange metallic sound amid the waves. Following it, the scouts discover a cave entrance exposed by low tide. Waves rock pieces of metal debris in the shallows, making them clang together. Inside, passages lead to a larger cave network. With the tide rising, the crew debates whether exploring further is worth the time and risk.

actions.resultDescription: Using scanners, the scouts trace the anomalies to an artifact inside the first chamber. The rising tide leaves little time to retrieve it. While retrieving the artifact, the crew discovers a passage to a deeper cave network. But time spent debating and scanning allows the rising tide to cut off access, preventing further exploration.
A thorough inspection reveals a rich metal ore vein extending into a deeper cave network. With the tide rising, the crew chooses to extract what ore they can rather than explore further.

Deeper in the caves, the scouts find a row of doors on the wall, each smaller than the last. None leads anywhere, painted. An air analyzer detects traces of incense used by Nasobi. Some crew members see an impressive artistic statement of one of Nasobies' artists; others see a waste of time. They debate modern art on the way back, but crew morale remains unchanged.

nodes.name: Field Research 2
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: spawn on Biome 01, Biome 06, Biome 10 = shallow
nodes.spawnConditions: spawn on Biome 01, Biome 06, Biome 10 = shallow
nodes.eventDescription: The scouts discover strange plants growing in neat rows across a patch of warm ground. They collect promising samples, but when one scout pulls at a root, the entire patch rises beneath their feet. Their garden is growing on the back of a huge beasts, luying in a pack and it is now awake.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: The crew slowly backs away, hoping the beasts will lose interest. Instead, the animals begin to surround them, showing coordinated hunting behavior. Two crew members are killed before the others can escape.

actions.resultDescription: The scouts shield themselves from the enraged beasts. During the confrontation, the equipment becomes coated in mucus secreted by the creatures. Analysis of the substance reveals how the beasts resist local infections, allowing the crew to improve their own defenses against native diseases.

The scouts scares the beasts away, and collect promising samples of metals and algae from their resting place before making a hasty retreat. Further analysis of the samples improves the crew’s understanding of local viruses.

The scouts attack the beasts, but the bullets fail to pierce their thick hides, merely driving them away and leaving no bodies to examine. However, the crew collects promising samples of metals and algae from their resting place. Further analysis of the biological samples improves their understanding of local viruses.

nodes.name: Field Research
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.location: spawn on Biome 01, Biome 06, Biome 10 = shallow
nodes.spawnConditions: spawn on Biome 01, Biome 06, Biome 10 = shallow
nodes.eventDescription: The scouts collect tissue samples from huge mollusk-like creatures in the tidal pools—a promising source of protein. Nearby, they find piles of shattered shells. One scout blames the surf; another points out that every shell is broken on the same side. Something here has a bigger appetite. As the crew packs up, a large beast emerges from behind the rocks and growls. They have been sampling its food.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Crew members challenged your decision, arguing that saving lives was a fundamental human duty. Your order not to intervene sparked prolonged debates in the crew quarters, lowering morale.

actions.resultDescription: The crew attacks first, but the beast’s thick hide prevents a fatal hit. Wounded, it flees. The fight gives the scouts valuable combat experience, and they return more confident in their ability to defend themselves against the local fauna.

A blast sends the beast fleeing behind the rocks and exposes mineral deposits beneath the shattered surface. The crew collects samples before making a hasty retreat. Everyone agrees the samples are not worth risking their lives for.

The crew tosses out bait. While the beast sniffs the unfamiliar food, they shoot it with a sample collection capsule. Startled, it flees, leaving behind a sample of its remarkably tough skin. Everyone agrees the samples are not worth risking their lives for and retreats.

nodes.name: The Ferals
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.eventDescription: The scouts see smoke in the distance, as if from a bonfire. They head toward that smoke when they are attacked by a group of men, humans. One of the scouts is grievously wounded. All attempts to reach out and communicate with the attackers are ignored. All they want is to spill the blood of your people; their hearts are full of murderous zeal.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: Crew members challenged your decision, arguing that saving lives was a fundamental human duty. Your order not to intervene sparked prolonged debates in the crew quarters, lowering morale.

actions.resultDescription: The crew fights back, killing some of the attackers and forcing the rest to fall back temporarily. Still outnumbered, the scouts use the opening to retreat. Later, a review of the expedition recordings reveals growths covering the attackers’ faces and damage to their suits. The crew suspects a local virus entered through the breaches and affected their brains, causing aggression similar to rabies, an ancient Earth disease.

There are too many attackers, and the crew is reluctant to hurt fellow humans. They decide to retreat quickly. Later, a review of the expedition recordings reveals growths covering the attackers’ faces and damage to their suits. The crew suspects a local virus entered through the breaches and affected their brains, causing aggression similar to rabies, an ancient Earth disease.

Outnumbered, the crew avoids close combat and calls in artillery fire to drive the attackers back. As they flee, they abandon several useful items, which the scouts collect as spoils. Later, a review of the expedition recordings reveals growths covering the attackers’ faces and damage to their suits. The crew suspects a local virus entered through the breaches and affected their brains, causing aggression similar to rabies, an ancient Earth disease.

nodes.name: Anomaly
nodes.title: New Event Block
nodes.eventDescription: Once above the island, the scouts fly their recon craft into the most dangerous airspace they have ever flown through. The sky appears to be littered with balls of lightning, unseen until you fly too close to them.

inactionThreat.description: Event times out without choice made.
inactionThreat.resultDescription: The scouts decide to land and wait out the storm. Ten minutes later, an enormous lightning bolt strikes the island, cutting off all communication with the team. Even after the storm subsides, contact cannot be restored. A rescue team is dispatched to investigate, but finds nothing at the landing site except a pool of molten metal where the recon craft once stood.

actions.description: Use the Basic Extractor to absorb the electrical energy and clear a path through the storm.
actions.resultDescription: As the device begins drawing in the discharges, the glowing spheres flicker and gradually dissipate. After several tense minutes, they manage to clear a narrow passage through the storm. The recon craft escapes the dangerous airspace and safely returns to the ship.

actions.description: Use specialized equipment to investigate the source of the lightning.
actions.resultDescription: The scouts attempt to locate the center of the storm and fly as far away from it as possible, carefully maneuvering between the lightning balls. After several tense minutes, the lightning becomes less frequent, and the recon craft eventually escapes the storm and returns safely to the ship.

actions.description: Fire metal projectiles to divert the lightning away from the recon craft.
actions.resultDescription: The plan works: electrical discharges strike the projectiles, briefly clearing a path through the storm. Taking advantage of the opening, the crew maneuvers through the remaining lightning balls and safely returns to the ship.

lines.text: Commander, the beacon frequency matches pre-collapse naval telemetry. Proceed with caution.
